name: Itoshiki Mafia ni Hanataba o
original_name: 愛しきマフィアに花束を
source:
A Mafia known also as Borujano controls a certain city. You are a member of Borujano and your life is being targeted by a rival Mafia organization. The leaders of Borujano believe this is because of information leaked by a spy. Thus, they order everyone to pair up with a partner to uncover the spy.

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiakaigai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
一个名为博鲁加诺的黑手党控制着某座城市。你是博鲁加诺成员，生命正受到敌对黑手党组织的威胁。博鲁加诺的首领认为这是因为间谍泄露了情报，于是命令所有人两两组队，找出间谍。

[来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiakaigai]Google Play[/url]]
